title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
Consumer Confidence (Aug) 89.4 vs 90.2 prior — 7-month low; gasoline above $4 weighing on sentiment.
BTC rejected at $81k 50-week MA (~$81,087); pulls back to ~$79k. 7th consecutive ETF inflow day ($338M Aug 24).
PCE (Jul) + Nvidia Q2 earnings both due Wed; Warsh at Jackson Hole Fri — key catalysts ahead.
